question: How can I track my order?
answer: Use the tracking link in your order confirmation email or open Orders in your account. If tracking has not updated, allow up to 24 hours for the carrier to refresh the status.
expected_keywords: tracking link; order confirmation; Orders page

question: I did not receive an order confirmation email. What should I do?
answer: Check your spam or promotions folder and confirm that you entered the correct email address. If the order appears in your account, it was recorded. Otherwise, contact support with the order date and payment reference.
expected_keywords: spam folder; correct email; order history

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: An address can usually be changed only before dispatch. Contact support promptly with your order number to check whether an update is possible.
expected_keywords: before dispatch; contact support; order number

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: You may request cancellation while the order is still being processed. Once dispatched, cancellation may no longer be possible and you may need to follow the return process.

question: Why is my order status not updating?
answer: Carrier tracking may take up to 24 hours to refresh after dispatch. If there is no update after that period, contact support with your order number.

question: Can I order without creating an account?
answer: If guest checkout is available, you can order using your email address and delivery details. Keep the confirmation email for reference.

question: I received the wrong item. What should I do?
answer: Do not use the item. Contact support with your order number and clear photos of the item and packaging.

question: Can two orders be combined into one shipment?
answer: Orders are generally processed separately once submitted. Contact support promptly, but combining orders cannot be guaranteed.
expected_keywords: separate orders; contact support; not guaranteed

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Delivery time depends on the destination and shipping option. Check the estimated delivery date in your order confirmation or tracking page.

question: My order is marked delivered, but I have not received it.
answer: Check with household members, neighbours, reception, or the designated safe place. If it is still missing, contact support with your order number.

question: Can I choose a delivery time slot?
answer: Available delivery slots, if offered, are shown during checkout. If no slot is displayed, a specific delivery time cannot be guaranteed.

question: What if I am unavailable when delivery is attempted?
answer: The carrier may make another attempt or leave collection or rescheduling instructions. Check the tracking page for the latest instructions.

question: Do you deliver to remote areas?
answer: Coverage depends on the courier and destination PIN code. Enter your PIN code at checkout to check availability.

question: Why is my delivery delayed?
answer: Delays can occur because of weather, high shipment volume, or carrier operations. Check tracking and contact support if the estimated date has passed.
expected_keywords: tracking page; estimated date; carrier delay

question: Can someone else receive my parcel?
answer: Another person at the delivery address may be able to receive the parcel, subject to the carrier's verification requirements.

question: How can I update my phone number for delivery?
answer: Contact support with your order number and corrected phone number as soon as possible. Changes may not be possible after carrier handoff.
expected_keywords: order number; corrected phone; carrier handoff

question: What is the return process?
answer: Review the item's return policy, then contact support or use the returns option in your account if available. Keep the item, packaging, and proof of purchase until resolved.
expected_keywords: return policy; account; proof of purchase

question: Can I return an item without original packaging?
answer: Requirements vary by item and seller policy. Contact support before sending it back to confirm packaging requirements.

question: How do I check if my item is eligible for return?
answer: Check the return conditions on the product page or in your order details. Some products may have different eligibility rules.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size?
answer: Exchange availability depends on the product and seller policy. Check your order details or contact support to confirm.

question: Who pays for return shipping?
answer: Responsibility depends on the reason for return and the applicable seller policy. Check the return instructions before shipping.
expected_keywords: return reason; seller policy; return instructions

question: I received a damaged product. Can I return it?
answer: Report the damage promptly through support. Include your order number and clear photos of the damaged item and packaging.

question: Can I return only one item from a multi-item order?
answer: If individually eligible, you may be able to return only the item you do not want. Check the return options for that item in your order.

question: What should I include in a return package?
answer: Follow the return instructions for your order. Include the item and required accessories or documentation, and use the return label if provided.

question: How long does a refund take?
answer: Timing depends on the payment method and the bank or payment provider. Check the refund confirmation and contact support if the stated timeframe has passed.
expected_keywords: payment method; bank processing; refund confirmation

question: Where will my refund be credited?
answer: Refunds are generally sent to the original payment method unless the applicable policy states otherwise. Check your refund confirmation.

question: My refund was approved but I have not received it.
answer: The bank or payment provider may need additional time to post the amount. Check your statement and contact support if the expected period has passed.

question: Can I get a refund to a different bank account?
answer: Refunds are generally returned to the original payment method. Contact support if that method is no longer available.
expected_keywords: original payment method; security; contact support

question: Will the delivery fee also be refunded?
answer: This depends on the reason for return and the applicable policy. Review the refund breakdown or contact support.

question: How can I cancel a refund request?
answer: Contact support with your order number and refund request reference. Whether it can be cancelled depends on its processing stage.
expected_keywords: order number; refund reference; processing stage

question: My payment was deducted but no order was created.
answer: The payment may remain pending or be reversed automatically if the order was not completed. Check your bank or payment app and contact support with the transaction reference if it is not reversed within the provider's timeframe.

question: Which payment methods are accepted?
answer: Accepted methods are displayed at checkout and may vary by region. Review the options before confirming your order.

question: Why was my card payment declined?
answer: A payment may be declined by the bank or payment provider. Check your card details, available balance, and bank notifications, or contact your bank.

question: Can I pay cash on delivery?
answer: Availability depends on the delivery location and order. If offered, it will appear during checkout.

question: I was charged twice for one order. What should I do?
answer: Check whether both entries are completed charges or one is a pending authorization. If both are completed, contact support with your order number and transaction references. Never share your full card number or security code.
expected_keywords: pending authorization; transaction references; card safety

question: Is it safe to save my payment details?
answer: Only save details if the checkout provider offers a secure payment-saving option and you are comfortable. Never share your password, OTP, CVV, or full card details with support.

question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
answer: Use Forgot Password on the sign-in page and follow the reset link or verification instructions sent to your registered email or phone.

question: How can I change my registered email address?
answer: Check account settings for an email-update option. If verification is required or you cannot access the account, contact support through the official channel.

question: How can I delete my account?
answer: Check account or privacy settings for a deletion option. Otherwise, contact official support about the deletion process and data-retention requirements.

question: I cannot log in. What should I do?
answer: Check your email or username and password. Try password reset and confirm your account is not temporarily locked. Contact support if the issue continues.

question: How can I update my delivery address for future orders?
answer: Sign in, open your address book or account settings, and edit or add the address. Check it carefully before your next order.
expected_keywords: address book; account settings; future orders

question: How can I find product specifications?
answer: Open the product page and review its description, specifications, images, and downloadable documents. Contact support if a detail is missing.

question: Is the product covered by a warranty?
answer: Coverage depends on the product, manufacturer, and purchase terms. Check the product listing and warranty documents or contact support with product and order details.

question: The product is out of stock. When will it be available?
answer: Restock dates may not be available. Check the product page periodically or use a stock notification option if provided.

question: How do I use or assemble my product?
answer: Refer to the user manual or setup guide supplied with the product. For further help, contact support with the product name and model.

question: How can I register a complaint?
answer: Contact support through the official help channel and describe the issue. Include relevant order details and evidence, but never share passwords, OTPs, or full card details.
expected_keywords: official help channel; order details; supporting evidence

question: How can I check my complaint status?
answer: Use the complaint or ticket reference provided when you submitted the issue. If you did not receive one, contact support with the submission date and email used.
expected_keywords: ticket reference; complaint status; submission date

question: I am not satisfied with the support response. What can I do?
answer: Reply to the existing support thread or request escalation through the official channel. Include the ticket reference and explain what remains unresolved.

question: How can I speak to a human support agent?
answer: Use the contact or live-chat option on the official support page and request a human agent. Availability may depend on support hours.
expected_keywords: human agent; live chat; support hours

question: What information should I provide when contacting support?
answer: Provide a short issue description and relevant order or ticket reference. Share only necessary information; never provide passwords, OTPs, CVVs, or full card numbers.
expected_keywords: issue description; reference number; protect credentials
